verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so letting it consume MCP servers' tools is a fair axis. The pack contains no evidence that Pipecat acts as an MCP client. The only MCP mention is context-hub registering itself as an MCP server with an external coding agent, which is the opposite role and earns no credit. Flows function calling is an adjacent feature, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
